_how: Lines of TODD.OS that flicker into the void. 'idle' can show any time. 'aware' starts once he's grown aware of you (from the 2nd visit, more often each time). 'papa' turns up now and then. 'disk' only shows if TODD's Floppy Disk is in their drawer. 'rage' floods the screen in red during a tantrum. 'notice' is what he says when he first notices your cursor ('notice_aware' instead, from the 2nd visit on), and 'approach' when he starts walking toward you (4th visit on). {visits} becomes how many times they've been here. 'held' is a different voice, in plain grey, right after he hits the screen in a tantrum: whatever it is that keeps him in.
idle: > it is very quiet in here
aware: > why do you keep coming back
notice_aware: > don't think i can't see you
approach: > let me get a better look at you
papa: > BIG PAPA BUILT THIS WORLD FROM NOTHING
> i could never be like him
disk: > BOOT DISK 1 ... checked out to: YOU
